Alex R.: Heads up — I just finished onboarding atlas-lite-60k (int3) to staging and kicked off a long-context soak. Seeing a weird KV-cache divergence when a long prefill crosses ~65k tokens.
Lee M.: ugh. any logs or a repro command?
Alex R.: minimal repro below. note the mismatch happens only when we combine a large prefill + streaming generation.
Alex R.: ```
./runtest --model atlas-lite-60k-int3 --quant int3 --prefill-file longprefill.txt --gen-steps 1024 --streaming true --seq-len 70000
# after ~65536 tokens the token stream diverges from reference
```
Sam T.: can you paste the short diff? is it a token shift or garbled tokens?
Alex R.: small excerpt of the decode mismatch: 
```
ref: ... "the committee concluded the review and approved the"
stg: ... "the committée concluded the review and approved the"
# spacing + accent char pops in, seems like an encoding/offset hit
```
Olivia P.: weird — accent char? suggests a byte/offset corruption, but atlas-lite is int3 so quantized arithmetic could surface bitflip-y artifacts. does it repro on cpu emulation?
Alex R.: tried CPU baseline (fp16) and it matches reference. Repro is only on int3 runtime paths on GPU.
Ben K.: tagging infra-bot to collect kernel/driver: @infra-bot can you collect GPU logs + pinned kernel versions for that run id 202603?
infra-bot: Received. Collecting /var/log/dmesg, nvidia-smi snapshots, and the fanout shim logs for run 202603. ETA ~2m. :gear:
Lee M.: hypothesis 1: KV-index wrap at near-power-of-two boundary (65536) causing an off-by-one in buffer offset calculation when compaction runs. Hypothesis 2: quantized kernel using packed bytes gets misaligned when prefix length % pack_size != 0.
Sam T.: good call. try forcing a smaller pack size or disable compaction in the serving config and re-run.
Alex R.: disabling compaction in the serving runtime avoided the divergence in a quick check. Still running a full pass.
Olivia P.: if disabling compaction fixes it, we should bisect between compaction code paths and the packing routine. Can someone write a small unit that simulates packed-KV memcopy alignment?
Ben K.: I'll spin up a quickCuda test that runs memcopy with random prefix sizes around 65536 and with int3 packing. Will post link.
Ben K.: https://staging-redwood/runs/202603/memcopy-packs — initial run shows misaligned memcpy when offset % 8 == 1 under the int3 packer.
Sam T.: that aligns with the observed accent (garbage bytes shifting into utf8 multi-byte char). That would show as accent or weird UTF sequences.
Lee M.: plan: 1) create small reproducer that isolates pack/unpack without full model, 2) add assert in compaction path verifying alignment invariants, 3) add a canary test in CI for large prefill sizes (64k+).
Alex R.: agree. I'll open a PR with failing reproducer and link to the staging run once the job finishes.
Olivia P.: also schedule a warm canary on dedicated to confirm it's not a hardware fluke. If it passes on different GPU arch maybe it's a kernel-specific issue.
Ben K.: queued canary on A10 + H100. results tomorrow morning.
Sam T.: FYI add an eval harness check to run a short quality regression on our golden prompts after the fix — want to ensure no invisible drift.
Alex R.: will do. PR and repro link coming shortly. Thanks all. :thank_you:
